title: 6D ATS-1R Apex TC-2

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The 6D Helmets 6D ATS-1R Apex TC-2 is purpose-built for closed-course competition and apex carving, purpose-built for riders demanding uncompromising high-speed aerodynamic stability and track-certified protection. Built around a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell weighing a featherweight 1320g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~93 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Carbon road race helmet with ODS technology for multi-directional impact.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for Intermediate Oval head shape; aggressive track fit with high cheek pads requires significant break-in time for comfort; runs slightly small in shell size compared to DOT equivalents.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the 6D Helmets 6D ATS-1R Apex TC-2: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the 6D Helmets 6D ATS-1R Apex TC-2. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in 6D Helmets's Track / Race lineup, the 6D ATS-1R Apex TC-2 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The 6D Helmets 6D ATS-1R Apex TC-2 represents 6D Helmets's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~93 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the 6D Helmets 6D ATS-1R Apex TC-2 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
